name: 25K Select Evaluation Account
description:
Tradeify 25K Select Evaluation Account. Parameters: $25,000 Starting Balance, Profit Target: $1,500, Maximum End-of-Day Trailing Drawdown: $1,000, Daily Loss Limit: None during evaluation (full intraday flexibility), Consistency Rule: 40% (no single day can represent more than 40% of total profit, requiring a minimum of 3 trading days to pass), Maximum Position Limit: 1 Mini Contract / 10 Micro Contracts.

Features & Benefits:
- Choice of Payout Policy AFTER passing: Select Flex (5-Day milestone payouts with larger caps) or Select Daily (smaller, frequent daily payouts with buffer system).
- No activation fees and instant activation upon hitting the target.
- Tier 1 news trading allowed.
- Purchase limits: Maximum 15 evaluation purchases per 30-day period, up to 10 resets per account per 30-day period, up to 5 sim funded active accounts simultaneously.
